rules.statement: The executing Court has jurisdiction to consider the legal effect of a bargain between a judgment-creditor and a judgment-debtor that affects the execution, discharge or satisfaction of the decree under section 344 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "This view rests upon the authority of the Privy Council in a case to which I shall presently refer. Section 47 corresponds with section 344 of our Code. Even, therefore, if the Judge was right in holding that there had been no adjustment which could be recorded under section 349 of the Civil Procedure Code, it was still necessary for him to consider under section 344 of the Civil Procedure Code whether the plaintiff's right to execution was controlled and if so to what extent and in what manner, by X 10 or by A, if A had superseded X 10."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 344 of the Civil Procedure Code
